magicTimeouts.description: Magic numbers in setTimeout/setInterval (e.g. setTimeout(fn, 3000) without a named constant)

emptyCatch.description: Empty catch blocks that swallow errors silently

noopTestAssertions.description: Test functions containing no recognized assertion call (expect(), assert(), assert.<method>(), or t.assert.<method>())

hardcodedRoutes.description: Hardcoded /api/... route strings instead of route constants

anyType.description: TypeScript `as any` casts or `: any` type annotations

consoleLogs.description: console.log() calls in production (non-test) source files

unusedParams.description: Function parameters that look unused (not prefixed with _)

mockShapeMismatch.description: Test mocks using .mockResolvedValue({}) or .mockReturnValue({}) with empty objects (likely missing required fields)
